def calculate_marked_cells(w1, h1, w2, h2):
    # Calculate the perimeter of the first rectangle
    perimeter_first = 2 * (w1 + h1)
    
    # Calculate the perimeter of the second rectangle
    perimeter_second = 2 * (w2 + h2)
    
    # Subtract the overlapping edges (bottom of first and top of second)
    overlapping_edges = 2 * w2
    
    # Total perimeter of the ship
    total_perimeter = perimeter_first + perimeter_second - overlapping_edges
    
    # Calculate additional cells around the entire ship
    # These are the cells that are adjacent to the ship but not part of the ship itself
    additional_cells = 2 * (w1 + w2 + h1 + h2) - 4  # Subtract the 4 corners counted twice
    
    # Total number of marked cells
    total_marked_cells = total_perimeter + additional_cells
    
    return total_marked_cells
